messages:
mike: Heads-up, prod routing spike — ~30% of /v1/generate requests are hitting the canary model and we're seeing tail latency + timeouts. Going to apply an emergency egress override to protect customer latency. @oncall please watch.
sarah: ack. which change are you planning?
mike: temporary rule: rewrite the X-Model-Target header for matches to route traffic to the stable pool. quick patch below:
```
route {
  match: path_prefix("/v1/generate") && header("X-Model-Variant") == "canary"
  action: rewrite_header("X-Model-Target", "stable")
  forward_to: stable-pool
}
```
alexa: header rewrite is fastest. we should also put a 1s circuit-breaker on the stable pool to avoid cascading failures.
jamal: agreed. i'll add the cb and flip the toggle. plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 2m, monitor 5xx and p99.
deploy-bot: triggered deploy 1762501245: config-change route/egress-override -> header-rewrite + cb. CI ✅.
mike: rolling now to 10%. watch latency/5xx dashboards.
sarah: seeing a small bump in stable 5xx after +30s, overall p95 down. holding at 50% for now.
alexa: if stable 5xx keeps trending up we rollback. what's the rollback procedure?
jamal: rollback = revert route change and restore previous weights: `rctl routes apply previous-route-config.yaml` (or `rctl routes set-weight /v1/generate canary 100` for immediate revert). keep monitor on.
oncall-bot: alert: stable-pool error-rate > 2% for 60s (rule: infra/pg-errors).
mike: pausing rollout at 50%. switching a subset to canary-slow-path to drain pressure: adding header `X-Force-LowQ` route to `canary-slow`.
deploy-bot: deploy 1762501302: added canary-slow path.
sarah: telemetry shows canary-slow p99 improved vs canary, but throughput lower — latency for users improved though. error-rate on stable trending down.
jamal: given the mixed signals i'm going to rollback to the pre-change config to be safe and re-evaluate routing rules in staging.
deploy-bot: rollback started 1762501399: rolled config -> previous-route-config.yaml.
mike: rollback complete. traffic restored to previous weights. doing KV cache rewarm and clearing route-local caches.
alexa: filing a postmortem and runbook edits. note: make header-override an oncall-gated operation and add an explicit emergency-toggle sequence in the runbook.
sarah: also add a dashboard panel for `header_override_count` and label by `config_version` so we can see rollouts at a glance.
mike: created follow-up ticket ENG-1427 for runbook + dashboard + gating. thanks all for quick responses :thumbsup:
